# CodeSparring - AI Mock Interview Platform
# https://codesparring.dev

> CodeSparring trains interview performance, not just problem-solving. LeetCode tests if you can solve problems alone. Real interviews test if you can think out loud under pressure. We train that skill.

## What is CodeSparring?

CodeSparring is an AI-powered mock interview platform for software engineers preparing for technical interviews. Unlike traditional coding practice platforms like LeetCode, CodeSparring simulates real interview conditions where you speak your solution out loud and receive feedback on communication, problem-solving approach, and code quality.

## The Problem We Solve

Many engineers grind 500+ LeetCode problems and still fail interviews. Why?

- **LeetCode tests**: Can you solve problems alone, in silence, with unlimited time?
- **Real interviews test**: Can you think out loud, handle pressure, communicate clearly, and collaborate with an interviewer?

These are different skills. CodeSparring closes this gap by training the actual skill that interviews test.

## Key Differentiators

### CodeSparring vs LeetCode

| Aspect | LeetCode ($35/month) | CodeSparring ($25/month) |
|--------|---------------------|-------------------------|
| Format | Solve problems alone in silence | Voice-enabled mock interviews |
| Feedback | Pass/fail on test cases | AI feedback on communication + code |
| Practice type | Algorithm drilling | Interview performance training |
| Real interview simulation | No | Yes |
| Price | $35/month | $25/month (29% cheaper) |

LeetCode is great for learning algorithms. CodeSparring is better for practicing the actual interview experience.

### CodeSparring vs Interviewing.io

| Aspect | Interviewing.io | CodeSparring |
|--------|----------------|--------------|
| Interviewer | Human engineers | AI interviewer |
| Price | $225 per session | $25/month unlimited |
| Availability | Requires scheduling | 24/7 |
| For 5 sessions | $1,125 | $25 |

Research shows 5 mock interviews doubles your pass rate. That costs $1,125 with humans or $25/month with CodeSparring - 45x less expensive.

### CodeSparring vs Pramp

| Aspect | Pramp | CodeSparring |
|--------|-------|--------------|
| Interviewer | Random peers | Consistent AI |
| Quality | Varies (30% report issues) | Consistent high quality |
| Scheduling | Required | Not needed, 24/7 |
| Format | Peer matching | Solo practice anytime |

## Core Features

1. **Voice-Enabled Mock Interviews**: Practice speaking your solution out loud like in real interviews
2. **AI Interviewer**: Asks follow-up questions and provides real-time feedback
3. **Spaced Repetition System**: SM-2 algorithm schedules practice for optimal long-term retention
4. **Company-Specific Prep**: 70+ companies including Google, Meta, Amazon, Apple, Netflix, Stripe, Airbnb, Uber, Microsoft
5. **15 DSA Patterns**: Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Trees, Graphs, Dynamic Programming, Backtracking, etc.
6. **Performance Analytics**: 40+ metrics tracking communication, problem-solving, and code quality
7. **24/7 Availability**: Practice anytime without scheduling
8. **Personalized Study Roadmap**: Custom prep plan based on target company and interview date

## Pricing

- **Free Plan**: 20+ problems with unlimited practice, full AI feedback. No credit card required.
- **Pro Monthly**: $25/month - 350+ problems, spaced repetition, personalized roadmap, company-specific prep
- **Pro Yearly**: $225/year (save 25%, $75/year savings)

## Target Users

- Software engineers preparing for technical interviews at any level
- Students applying for internships at tech companies
- Career changers entering software development
- Anyone who can solve LeetCode but struggles in actual interviews
- Engineers targeting FAANG, top tech companies, or high-growth startups

## Technology

- Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Firebase
- AI-powered by Claude (Anthropic) for natural interview conversations
- Uses SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm for learning optimization
- Monaco code editor with real-time execution
